sentences.text:
Petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking following reliefs:-
"10.1

That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct party respondents to stop digging in and around the land of the petitioner with immediate effect and to lawfully proceed to acquire the land(s) of the petitioner.

10.2 That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct party respondents to pay to the petitioenr lawfull sum of compensation, after conducting proper land acquisition proceedgins vis-a-vis his land(s) which is /are affected by the impugned act of SECL & other prty respondents.

10.3 That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to pay compensation and interests thereon to the petitioner; to extend rehabilitation & resettlement benefits to him; and also, to offer him the employment opportunities in terms of the approved SOPs(Standard Operating Procedures) for land-outsees employment.

10.4 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct party respondents to conduct, if needed, measurement of the affected portions of the land(s) of the Uday Prasad Kenwat vs South Eastern Coalfields Limited on 8 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42233886/

entities.text: Uday Prasad Kenwat vs South Eastern Coalfields Limited
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2 petitioner.
10.5 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct party respondents to act within any stipulated period of time.
10.6 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly pass an order to the effect that erroring government officers are punished according to the law & rules made thereunder.

10.7 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly pass an order to the effect that the petitioner is provided with an exemplary amount of compensation for unnecessary hardships suffered by him owing to the impugned act of party respondents.
10.8. Any other relief, which this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper, may also kindly be granted in favor of the petitioner in the interest of justice."

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the relief prayed for in the writ petition,
he may be permitted to withdraw this writ petition, at this stage, with liberty to submit a fresh representation for consideration before respondent authorities and respondent authorities shall be directed to take decision on the representation to be submitted by the petitioners within specified time.

3. Learned counsel for respondents No.1 to 10 submits that in view of the limited prayer made by counsel for petitioner, he is having no objection, if the representation is submitted it will be considered strictly in accordance with law.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the documents enclosed along with petition.

5. Considering the submission made by counsel for respective parties, this writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to petitioner to submit representation before respondents No.1 to 10 as prayed for and if such representation is submitted by the petitioner, the concerned authority shall consider and decide the same expeditiously preferably within a further period of 8 weeks from the date of receipt of representation.

Sd/-
